93693.subject: Technical Drawing
93693.question_text: Construct a perpendicular bisector to a line segment AB of length 60 mm. Label all construction lines and points clearly.
93693.explanation:
1. Draw line segment AB = 60 mm.
2. With A as center, draw an arc above and below AB with radius greater than half of AB.
3. With B as center, draw arcs intersecting the previous arcs at points C and D.
4. Join C and D to form the perpendicular bisector.
5. Label all points and construction lines clearly.

93694.subject: Technical Drawing
93694.question_text: Construct a regular hexagon with side length 30 mm using the circumscribed circle method. Show all construction lines.
93694.explanation:
1. Draw a circle with radius 30 mm.
2. Mark a point A on the circumference.
3. Using the same radius, step off points B, C, D, E, and F around the circumference.
4. Join the points A, B, C, D, E, and F to form the hexagon.
5. Label all points and construction lines clearly.

93695.subject: Technical Drawing
93695.question_text: Construct a tangent to a circle of radius 25 mm from an external point P, 50 mm from the center of the circle. Show all construction lines.
93695.explanation:
1. Draw the circle with center O and radius 25 mm.
2. Mark point P 50 mm from O.
3. Join OP and bisect it to find midpoint M.
4. With M as center and radius OM, draw a semicircle intersecting the original circle at points T and T'.
5. Join PT and PT' to form the tangents.
6. Label all points and construction lines clearly.

93696.subject: Technical Drawing
93696.question_text: Draw the front, top, and right-side views of the given isometric block (dimensions: 40 mm × 30 mm × 20 mm). Use first-angle orthographic projection.
93696.explanation:
1. Draw the front view (40 mm × 20 mm).
2. Draw the top view (40 mm × 30 mm) directly above the front view.
3. Draw the right-side view (30 mm × 20 mm) to the right of the front view.
4. Ensure all views are aligned and use correct projection lines.
5. Label all dimensions and views clearly.

93697.subject: Technical Drawing
93697.question_text: Draw a full sectional front view of the given object (a hollow cylinder with outer diameter 50 mm, inner diameter 30 mm, and height 40 mm) along the vertical axis. Show all hidden details.
93697.explanation:
1. Draw the outer circle (diameter 50 mm) and inner circle (diameter 30 mm) for the front view.
2. Draw vertical lines to represent the height (40 mm).
3. Hatch the sectioned area with 45° lines.
4. Show hidden lines for the inner diameter.
5. Label all dimensions and section lines clearly.

93698.subject: Technical Drawing
93698.question_text: Draw an isometric view of a rectangular block with dimensions 60 mm × 40 mm × 30 mm. Include all construction lines.
93698.explanation:
1. Draw the isometric axes at 30° to the horizontal.
2. Mark lengths along the axes: 60 mm (length), 40 mm (width), and 30 mm (height).
3. Complete the block by drawing parallel lines.
4. Show all construction lines and label dimensions clearly.

93699.subject: Technical Drawing
93699.question_text: Develop the lateral surface of a right circular cone with base diameter 50 mm and slant height 60 mm. Show all construction lines.
93699.explanation:
1. Draw the base circle (diameter 50 mm).
2. Calculate the circumference of the base ($C = \pi d = 50 imes \pi$ mm).
3. Draw a sector of a circle with radius 60 mm and arc length equal to the base circumference.
4. Label all points and construction lines clearly.

93700.subject: Technical Drawing
93700.question_text: Draw the line of intersection between a vertical cylinder (diameter 40 mm) and a horizontal cylinder (diameter 30 mm) whose axes intersect at right angles. Show all construction lines.
93700.explanation:
1. Draw the orthographic views of both cylinders.
2. Divide the circles into equal parts (e.g., 12).
3. Project points from the top view to the front view.
4. Join the points to form the intersection curve.
5. Label all points and construction lines clearly.

93701.subject: Technical Drawing
93701.question_text: Dimension the given orthographic views of a stepped block (front and top views) according to standard dimensioning conventions. Include all necessary dimensions.
93701.explanation:
1. Dimension overall lengths, widths, and heights.
2. Dimension each step separately.
3. Use extension lines, dimension lines, and arrowheads correctly.
4. Place dimensions outside the views where possible.
5. Label all dimensions clearly.

93702.subject: Technical Drawing
93702.question_text:
Prepare a working drawing of a simple bracket with the following details:
- Base plate: 80 mm × 50 mm × 10 mm
- Vertical plate: 60 mm × 40 mm × 10 mm
- Two holes of diameter 10 mm on the base plate.
Include all necessary views, dimensions, and a title block.
93702.explanation:
1. Draw the front, top, and side views of the bracket.
2. Dimension all features (plates, holes, and thicknesses).
3. Include a title block with the drawing title, scale, date, and name.
4. Use standard line types and lettering.
5. Label all views and dimensions clearly.
